correctness.rationale: WLOG fixing {0,1,2} in F is valid by vertex-transitivity for isomorphism-invariant properties (nonempty case; empty family has diversity 0 < n-3 so irrelevant). Pool P_n = triples meeting {0,1,2} minus {0,1,2} has sizes 63/84/108/135/165, verified. Every other edge must meet {0,1,2} else disjoint from it, so F = {E0} + pairwise-intersecting subfamily of P_n; solver conflict propagation exactly encodes pairwise intersectingness. Miss/degree encoding verified: gamma>=t iff miss(v)>=t all v; non-star delta>=4 iff miss>=1 and deg>=4 all v (star = exists v with miss 0). Witness T_n identities checked: |T_n|=3n-8, Delta=2n-5, gamma=n-3, delta=3, intersecting, non-star — all recomputed. Upper bounds re-executed: diversity UNSAT t=n-2 for n=9..13 returns False with node counts 9975/19550/35204/59331/95093 matching DRAFT; min-degree non-star delta>=4 UNSAT for n=9..13 returns False with nodes 15919/68485/274505/1010124/3410894 matching DRAFT (n=12 in 9.9s, n=13 in 35.7s). SAT controls pass (diversity t=n-3 SAT in 9 nodes; non-star deg>=3 SAT), so solver is not vacuously UNSAT. Independent verifier verify.py with different code path re-proves all five diversity UNSATs (nodes 13093/26447/48753/83559/135841). Brute-force 2^|P| cross-check on n=6 over 5 miss/degree vectors all match solver. Fresh independent DFS re-proved n=9 min-degree UNSAT. No extremal-uniqueness claim is made; DRAFT explicitly disclaims it. Evidence is machine-checked exhaustive proof (finite case analysis), not human induction, but sound and replayable in stdlib-only seconds-to-~40s.

originality.rationale: Live retrieval confirms gap. Kupavskii 1709.02829 proves Frankl diversity bound C(n-3,k-2) only for n>=C*k (large n) and discusses 2k<n<3k only to refute a generalization — no exact D(9)-D(13) for k=3. Frankl-Wang 2304.11089 proves diversity <= C(n-3,k-2) for n>36k (large n) — disjoint regime. Han-Kohayakawa 1509.05464 gives third-level edge bound 2n-2 for k=3 — constrains |F| only, does not determine Delta or gamma. Frankl-Wang 2207.05487 gives covering-number-three edge inequality for k>=7 then all cases — edge count only, no per-family degree/diversity table. Patkos 2501.02596 gives order-of-magnitude beta_{p,q} and large-n exact beta_{p,1}, beta_{p,2} — asymptotic/large-n, no small-n census. Huang 1804.11269 disproves Frankl n>=3k conjecture for k large and 3k<n<(2+sqrt3)k via t=6 lifting construction — requires k sufficiently large; for k=3 the construction collapses to 10-set G with diversity 5 < n-3, so it does not anticipate or imply D(n)=n-3 for n=9..13. The triangle witness is the known A2 two-out-of-three family, but its maximality in the exact small window n=9..13 (including n=10,11 inside Huang's asymptotic failure interval) is not in any source. Edge bounds cannot be rearranged into diversity maxima without per-family Delta profiles. Not arithmetic substitution, not renamed implementation.

value.rationale: Diversity gamma=|F|-Delta and min-degree star-forcing are recognized EKR-stability refinements (Frankl 1987 stability, Kupavskii/Frankl-Wang/Patkos programs). Exact values D(n)=n-3 (clean formula = Frankl bound C(n-3,1)) and d(n)=3 (delta>=4 forces star) for n=9..13, k=3 pin the Fano/HM/star competition window just above the Fano plane (7) and n=2k degeneracy (6) — a natural structural boundary, not arbitrary slice. Payoff is structural: confirms Frankl bound holds at k=3, n=9..13 despite its general failure just above 3k for large k, and gives degree-stability base values plus reusable certificate template. Not textbook (no textbook tabulates these exact maxima/thresholds), not mere parameter substitution (requires degree profiles beyond edge counts), not tiny unmotivated gain (5-point window with uniform formula + threshold), not unexplained enumeration (values fit closed forms with explicit extremal family, honest non-uniqueness disclaimer). Independently worth finding later as induction base and benchmark.

decisive_checks: Re-ran div_solver.py diversity UNSAT t=n-2 for n=9,10,11,12,13: False with nodes 9975/19550/35204/59331/95093, pools 63/84/108/135/165 — match DRAFT.
Re-ran min-degree non-star deg>=4 UNSAT for n=9,10,11,12,13: False with nodes 15919/68485/274505/1010124/3410894 (n=12 9.9s, n=13 35.7s) — match DRAFT.
Ran verify.py: witnesses |F|=19/22/25/28/31, Delta=13/15/17/19/21, gamma=6/7/8/9/10, mindeg=3, intersecting=True; all five diversity UNSATs re-proved (nodes 13093/26447/48753/83559/135841).
SAT controls: diversity t=n-3 SAT (n=9,10, 9 nodes); non-star deg>=3 SAT (n=9, 15 nodes) — solver not vacuously UNSAT.
Brute-force 2^|P| vs solver on n=6 over 5 miss/degree vectors: all match. Fresh independent DFS re-proved n=9 min-degree UNSAT (109673 nodes).
Hand-verified witness arithmetic: |T_n|=1+3(n-3)=3n-8, deg(core)=1+2(n-3)=2n-5, deg(off-core)=3, gamma=n-3; intersecting since any two 2-subsets of a 3-set meet; non-star since all miss>=1.
Verified WLOG {0,1,2} relabelling, pool completeness, miss/degree encodings, and DRAFT's explicit non-claim of extremal uniqueness and superseded fallback.
residual_risks: Computer-assisted proof: soundness rests on code review plus differential testing and brute-force spot checks, not formal machine-checked verification of the solver itself; a correlated bug in both implementations is unlikely but not logically excluded.
Scope is exactly k=3, n=9..13; no generalization to larger n/k is proved, and extremal-type classification (uniqueness) is explicitly left open — n=9 already has non-triangle optima per DRAFT.
Min-degree UNSAT at n=13 takes ~36s (within one-hour budget but slowest leg); reproduction requires running the bundled stdlib scripts.
